chapter_title_en: The Bloody Battle of the Eight Aspect Worlds
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch255: Xiao Chen Battles Three Demigods and the Golden Lion King
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen unleashes the Eight-Aspect Worlds against three top cultivators, wounds them with ruthless tactics, but his escape leads to a dreaded encounter with the Golden Lion King on the Demon Plain.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch255: Xiao Chen's Desperate Fight and the Golden Lion King's Return
og_description: In a breathtaking battle, Xiao Chen uses body-sacrifice strategies to hold off Heavenly Demon, Cihang, and Rome experts, then faces the mysterious Golden Lion King in human form.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen fights three experts and escapes, only to confront the Golden Lion King's terrifying new form. A mythic xianxia chapter of non-stop action.
